content_units: Context used: one adult in   America/Toronto   timezone, daily meds at fixed times, and   amoxicillin 500 mg every 8 hours   from   2026-07-10 through 2026-07-17 inclusive  . Quiet hours are   22:00–06:30  , so the antibiotic schedule is aligned to avoid overnight alerts.
Reminder   Active Dates   Exact Time   Notification Title   Short Message Text
Levothyroxine   Daily, ongoing   07:00   Take levothyroxine now   Take levothyroxine on an empty stomach. Wait before breakfast.
Vitamin D   Daily, ongoing   12:30   Take vitamin D with lunch   Take vitamin D with food at lunch.
Amoxicillin dose 1   2026-07-10 to 2026-07-17   06:30   Amoxicillin 500 mg — morning dose   Take 1 capsule now. Next doses are later today.
Amoxicillin dose 2   2026-07-10 to 2026-07-17   14:30   Amoxicillin 500 mg — afternoon dose   Take 1 capsule now. Keep doses evenly spaced today.
Amoxicillin dose 3   2026-07-10 to 2026-07-17   22:00   Amoxicillin 500 mg — night dose   Take 1 capsule now. This is today’s last antibiotic dose.
- The   8-hour antibiotic cadence   is set to   06:30, 14:30, 22:00   to fit inside allowed hours.
- This keeps the morning antibiotic exactly at quiet-hours end and avoids alerts between   22:01 and 06:29  .
- On   2026-07-17  , the final amoxicillin alert is   22:00  .
Alert Logic for Snooze, Missed Doses, and Duplicates
- If user taps “Taken,” cancel any pending snoozes for that dose
- If marked taken, cancel pending snoozes for that dose
- Max snooze window:   up to 60 min after scheduled time
- Stop snoozes immediately after dose is marked taken
-   Amoxicillin:   not confirmed within   2 hours   of scheduled time
-   Levothyroxine:   You missed today’s levothyroxine reminder. Follow your care plan before taking late.
-   Vitamin D:   You missed today’s vitamin D reminder. You can usually take it later with food if appropriate.
-   Amoxicillin:   You missed an amoxicillin dose. Follow your prescription guidance for late doses and do not double up unless instructed.
- Keep the dose card in app as   Missed   until user logs it or dismisses it
- For amoxicillin, do   not   auto-shift later doses; keep the original schedule to preserve consistency
- Use a unique key per dose instance:
- For each dose instance, allow only one active state at a time:
- Do not send the base reminder if the dose was already marked   taken   early
- Do not send more than one snooze notification for the same dose at the same timestamp
- Cancel all future notifications for that dose once status becomes   taken   or   skipped
- If app/device reconnects and retries queued pushes, suppress any notification whose dose status is no longer `scheduled` or `snoozed`
- If the user logs the same dose from two devices, first successful update wins; later duplicate events should be ignored
- For daylight-saving or timezone re-evaluation, store both:
- resolved local scheduled datetime for each dose instance
Option 1: 07:00 Levothyroxine   Empty-stomach morning reminder   Daily fixed time
Option 2: 12:30 Vitamin D   Lunch-time reminder with food   Daily fixed time
Option 3: 06:30 / 14:30 / 22:00 Amoxicillin   Three reminders per day for 8 days   Every 8 hours within quiet-hour limits
